items.exampleEn: The simplification of the online form has saved users a lot of time.
items.exampleZh: 線上表單簡化後，替使用者省下了很多時間。

items.exampleEn: The symbol for pi looks a little like a small table.
items.exampleZh: 圓周率的符號看起來有點像一張小桌子。

items.exampleEn: Gravitation keeps the moon moving around the earth.
items.exampleZh: 因為有萬有引力，月球才會繞著地球轉。

items.exampleEn: Our pedantic tour guide corrected every date we got wrong.
items.exampleZh: 我們那位吹毛求疵的導遊，把我們說錯的每個日期都糾正了。
items.glossZh: 吹毛求疵的；賣弄學問的

items.exampleEn: Scholasticism tried to bring faith and reason together.
items.exampleZh: 經院哲學試圖結合信仰與理性。

items.exampleEn: "Make a decision" is a common collocation in English.
items.exampleZh: 「make a decision」是英文中常見的字詞搭配。

items.exampleEn: The pH of this water is good for the fish in the tank.
items.exampleZh: 這種水的酸鹼值很適合魚缸裡的魚。

items.exampleEn: Predicative adjectives come after verbs such as be and seem.
items.exampleZh: 敘述用法的形容詞會出現在 be、seem 這類動詞之後。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't be so pedantic; the small details don't matter here.
items.sentenceZh: 別這麼吹毛求疵了，這些小細節在這裡不重要。

items.audioEn: In this experiment, you will test the pH of three kinds of drinks.
items.audioZh: 在這個實驗中，你們要測試三種飲料的酸鹼值。

items.sentenceEn: Learning collocations helps you sound more natural in English.
items.sentenceZh: 學習字詞搭配能讓你的英文聽起來更自然。

items.sentenceEn: Without gravitation, everything would float away into space.
items.sentenceZh: 如果沒有萬有引力，所有東西都會飄進太空。

items.stemEn: In math class, we learned that ____ is used to find the area of a circle.
items.stemZh: 數學課上，我們學到圓周率可以用來算圓的面積。

items.stemEn: In the sentence "the sky is blue", the word blue is used in a ____ way.
items.stemZh: 在 the sky is blue 這句裡，blue 是敘述用法。

items.passageEn: Mr. Hsu teaches both science and English at a small school, and students love his classes. In science, he explains gravitation by dropping two balls from a window, and he lets students test the pH of rain water. He says some simplification is fine for beginners, as long as the fundamental idea is correct. In English class, he teaches collocations, such as "heavy rain", instead of single words. He also explains technical terms like "predicative adjective" without sounding pedantic. Once a year, he even gives a fun talk about scholasticism in old European universities and about pi, a number his students love to remember.
items.passageZh: 許老師在一所小學校同時教科學和英文，學生都很喜歡他的課。科學課上，他從窗戶丟下兩顆球來解釋萬有引力，還讓學生測試雨水的酸鹼值。他說，只要基本概念正確，對初學者做一些簡化沒關係。英文課上，他教的是字詞搭配，例如 heavy rain，而不是單一的單字。他也能解釋「敘述用法形容詞」這類專業術語，卻不會讓人覺得賣弄學問。他每年甚至會辦一場有趣的演講，談古代歐洲大學的經院哲學，以及學生最愛背的圓周率。

questions.questionZh: 許老師怎麼解釋萬有引力？
許老師在英文課上教什麼？

items.promptZh: 那種解釋只是把事實簡化了。
referenceEn: That explanation is only a simplification of the facts.
That explanation is just a simplification of what really happened.
rubricZh: simplification 是名詞（例如 a simplification of…）

items.promptZh: 我的老師對文法非常吹毛求疵。
referenceEn: My teacher is very pedantic about grammar.
My teacher is extremely pedantic when it comes to grammar.
rubricZh: pedantic 是形容詞，表示「吹毛求疵的」（例如 is very pedantic about… 等）
「對文法」可寫，例如 about grammar、when it comes to grammar 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
